notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] New game won't get stuck on the loading.
[*] Now you can play with any screen resolution.
[*] Monster won't spawn on loaded.
[*] Double-click can gather single cards that are the same and stack them together.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update (25 Feb 2024)
notes.content:
Hello, my friend  here are some updates and bug fixes as shown below:
